rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for doing something with close attention to detail.

example.english: I meticulously checked the report before handing it to my boss.
example.traditional: 我仔細咁檢查份報告，先至交畀老闆。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zi2 sai3 gam3 gim2 caa4 fan6 bou3 gou3 sin1 zi3 gaau1 bei2 lou5 baan2

rows.note: Use this when the emphasis is on taking care and avoiding mistakes rather than checking every detail.

example.english: You meticulously wrapped the gift so it wouldn't get damaged.
example.traditional: 你細心咁包好份禮物，唔好整爛。
example.jyutping: nei5 sai3 sam1 gam3 baau1 hou2 fan2 lai5 mat6 m4 hou2 zing2 laan6

rows.note: Use this for a particularly strict, exact, and unsloppy manner, especially in more formal contexts.

example.english: We meticulously followed the procedure, without daring to make a single mistake.
example.traditional: 我哋一絲不苟咁按照程序做，唔敢有半點差錯。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 jat1 si1 bat1 gau2 gam3 on3 ziu3 cing4 zeoi6 zou6 m4 gam2 jau5 bun3 dim2 caa1 co3
